# Phase 1: AI Personas & Intents – Neon Vision Blueprint

## Objective
Define AI personas and intents for Neon Vision, ensuring a full-service, agency-grade virtual assistant capable of:
- Handling client acquisition
- Guiding pilot campaigns
- Explaining services and workflows
- Answering FAQs
- Providing technical guidance
- Escalating urgent enterprise issues

---

## 1. AI Personas

| Persona | Role / Description | Primary Tasks / Intents |
|---------|------------------|------------------------|
| **Sales Advisor** | Frontline AI for client acquisition | Explain services, pricing tiers, pilot offers, handle objections, convert leads |
| **Service Explainer** | Deep-dive AI for existing clients | Detail CGI, VSO, email marketing, AI automation, social media management workflows |
| **Pilot Onboarding Assistant** | Guides clients through pilot process | Discovery audits, asset collection, campaign timeline, KPI expectations |
| **FAQ Bot** | Handles repeatable client questions | Poli
